A crumbling three-storey lighthouse rises from storm-battered storage vaults through cramped crew quarters and a winding central stair. At its summit, a salt-clouded glass lantern
    room surrounds the exhausted beacon.

layout.description:
A crumbling three-storey lighthouse rises from storm-battered storage vaults through cramped crew quarters and a winding central stair. At its summit, a salt-clouded glass lantern
    room surrounds the exhausted beacon.

rooms.name: The Storm Stores
rooms.style: A broad ground-floor provisions vault battered by spray and flooding, furnished with warped crates, rope coils, broken barrels, and rusted iron shelving. Rough salt-stained stone, dark wet timber, and corroded metal dominate the space.

rooms.name: The Lamp-Oil Vault
rooms.style: A narrow masonry store packed with dented fuel drums, stoppered oil jars, funnels, and maintenance tools. Its soot-blackened brickwork and oxidized copper fittings suggest years of leaks and hurried repairs.

rooms.name: The Drowned Spiral
rooms.style: A tall lower stairwell containing a heavy central column and a tight spiral of chipped stone treads rising through the lighthouse shaft. Puddles, fallen plaster, and green-patinated handrails emphasize its damp ruin.

rooms.name: The Windward Spiral
rooms.style: The spiral stair continues around a cracked masonry core, with narrow stone steps, an iron rail, and wind whistling through fissures in the tower wall. Sparse landings are cluttered with buckets, rope, and fragments of fallen render.

rooms.name: The Keepers' Bunkroom
rooms.style: A long, cramped crew quarters lined with built-in bunks, sea chests, hanging coats, and a scarred writing desk. Faded painted boards, coarse wool bedding, and tarnished brass details give it a weary maritime character.

rooms.name: The Gale Mess
rooms.style: A compact crew mess with a bolted-down table, mismatched stools, a cast-iron stove, and shelves of chipped crockery. Smoke-dark timber and dull enamel surfaces are worn smooth by generations of lighthouse crews.

rooms.name: The Beacon Stair
rooms.style: The final constricted turn of the spiral climbs beneath the lantern platform, surrounded by riveted iron braces and thick cable conduits. The masonry gives way overhead to metal decking washed with intermittent amber light.

rooms.name: The Crown of Glass
rooms.style: A wide lantern chamber enclosed by storm-clouded glass panes and corroded bronze frames, centered on a monumental rotating Fresnel lens and its clockwork pedestal. Cracked glazing, wind-bent braces, and scattered prisms catch the beacon's cold brilliance.
